extracted.name: Very Berry Float / Graham Trifle
extracted.description: Perfect for your holiday sweet tooth.
ingredient_lines: 1 c All-purpose cream, or as needed
1/2 small can Condensed milk, or to taste
instruction_lines: Lay grahams biscuits at the bottom of your bowl/dish.
Mix together the cream and condensed according to your preferred sweetness.
Pour on top of biscuits. Make layers of biscuits and cream as desired, depending on your quantity of ingredients.
Top with thawed mixed berries. No need to be neat, as the berry colors pop out nicely on the bed of cream mix.
